RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday,  the March 12, 2008/Phalguna 22, 1929 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Commerce and Industry; Defence; Earth Sciences; Home Affairs;
Information and Broadcasting; Labour and Employment; Parliamentary
Affairs; Rural Development; Science and Technology; Textiles)
Total number of questions — 20
56
Gender based discrimination against
SSC women officers in IAF
*181. SHRIMATI BRINDA KARAT:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that SSC women
officers in IAF are facing gender based
discrimination which is affecting their
service terms and conditions, whereas the
similarly placed male SSC officers are being
considered for permanent commission;
(b) if so, the action taken by the
Ministry; and
(c) if not, the reasons for the delay?
Possible dangers due to intrusion
†*182. DR. PRABHA THAKUR: Will
the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether there is a decrease in the
intrusion in various States by the foreign
intruders on the various borders of the
country during the last two years;
(b) the details of the possible dangers
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
that might occur from such intruders coming
from the neighbouring countries;
(c) the measures taken by Government
to curb such intrusion;
(d) the extent of effectiveness of these
measures; and
(e) the details thereof?
Low investment in R&D
*183. SHRI N.R. GOVINDARAJAR:
Will the Minister of SCIENCE AND
TECHNOLOGY be pleased to state:
(a) whether investment in Research and
Development in Science and Technology
in India remains below the required level as
compared to the other developing countries;
(b) whether Government proposes to
liberalize Research and Development
system to enhance scientific activities in
the country;
(c) whether Government has submitted
any plan for Research and Development in
Science and Technology to the Planning
Commission; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?

57
Demand for censoring television
content
*184. SHRI GIREESH KUMAR
SANGHI:
SHRI JESUDASU SEELAM:
 Will the Minister of INFORMATION
AND BROADCASTING be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government is aware of the
increasing demand from social activists to
regulate television content;
(b) whether it has been suggested that
the Censor Board should certify the TV
broadcast;
(c) if so, the details of such censor; and
(d) by when a final decision in this
regard is likely to be taken?
Viability of SEZs in present economic
scenario
*185. SHRI D. RAJA: Will the Minister
of COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has done any
study or assessed the impact of the recent
global economic slowdown on the use and
future of the numerous Special Economic
Zones (SEZs) sanctioned in the country in
the last two years;
(b) whether it is a fact that the
international economic slowdown will
impact the Indian exports;
(c) if so, whether Government will do a
rethink on the utility of SEZs in the near
future;
(d) whether it is also a fact that the
targets of new units have fallen behind in
SEZs; and
(e) what steps are being proposed to
review the viability of SEZs in the present
economic climate?
Change in SEZ policy
*186. SHRI PENUMALLI MADHU:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is
contemplating to change the present policy
of Special Economic Zones (SEZs);
(b) if so, what are the changes
contemplated;
(c) how many SEZs have been approved
by Government and how many applications
are still pending; and
(d) what is the total area of land which
is earmarked by Government for the
formation of these approved SEZs?
Terrorist plots in Karnataka
*187. SHRI RAJEEV CHANDRA-
SEKHAR: Will the Minister of HOME
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) the details of terrorist plots and
terror suspects recently detected in the
State of Karnataka;
(b) the names of districts that have been
infiltrated;
(c) whether the terrorist outfits involved
have connections, if any, with foreign
countries and organizations; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Molestation by IAF officers
*188. SHRI HARISH RAWA T:
SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
 Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that three Indian
Air Force officers were charged with
molesting a girl aboard the New Delhi-
Bhubaneswar Rajdhani Express in
December, 2007; and

58
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(b) if so, the details thereof and what
action has been taken by the Air Force
against such officers?
Employment under NREGP
*189. SHRIMATI HEMA MALINI:
Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the National
Rural Employment Guarantee Programme
(NREGP) happens to be world's biggest
and ambitious social security scheme;
(b) if so, the number of unemployed
got employment since its enactment in
September, 2005;
(c) whether it is also a fact that the Act
is meant for improving working conditions
and bringing about investments in
productive assets; and
(d) if so, what action has been taken on
the above?
Credit cards to craftsmen and
weavers
†*190. SHRIMATI MAYA SINGH:
Will the Minister of TEXTILES be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government has formulated
any plan to give credit cards to craftsmen
and weavers under Self-Employment
Scheme, if so, the details thereof;
(b) the number of craftsmen and weavers
issued credit cards so far, State-wise;
and
(c) whether, keeping in view the
economic plight of craftsmen and weavers,
the economic assistance or facilities being
provided to them?
Shortage of skilled labour in the
developing industries
†*191. SHRI AJAY SINGH
CHAUTALA: W ill the Minister of
LABOUR AND EMPLOYMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a large number
of labour force is available in the country;
(b) if so, whether it is also a fact that
inspite of that there is a shortage of skilled
labourers in the developing industries; and
(c) whether Government would
implement a time-bound action plan at
national level by fixing a target for increasing
the skilled labour force in the country?
Requirement of aircrafts for the Navy
†*192. MS. SUSHILA TIRIYA: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that number of
reconnaissance and 'Sea-Harrier' aircrafts
has decreased continuously;
(b) if so, the number of aircrafts, engaged
in the work of reconnaissance, destroyed
so far including 'Sea-Harrier' aircrafts;
(c) whether requirement of
reconnaissance and 'Sea-Harrier' aircrafts
has become more relevant for Navy in the
present context; and
(d) if so, the steps Government is taking
to meet the requirement of reconnaissance
and 'Sea-Harrier' aircrafts for the Navy?
Declaration of 2007 as year of water
†*193. SHRIMA TI SUSHMA
SWARAJ : Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a)  whether it is a fact that even after

59
year 2007 being declared as year for water,
there are several villages which are deprived
of drinking water;
(b) if so, the details of such villages,
State-wise; and
(c) the efforts Government is making to
provide water in these villages?
Recommendations of TRAI on FM
radio
*194. DR. M.A.M. RAMASWAMY:
MS. SUSHILA TIRIYA:
 Will the Minister of INFORMATION
AND BROADCASTING be pleased to
state:
(a) whether FM radio has grown rapidly
in our country;
(b) whether the Telecom Regulatory
Authority of India (TRAI) in a
communication to the Government has
recommended several steps to be taken to
achieve a sustained growth in FM radio;
(c) if so, the other major
recommendations of TRAI regarding FM
radio; and
(d) the reaction of the Central
Government in this regard?
Commercial operations by SEZs
*195. SHRI SITARAM YECHURY:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the details of the SEZs approved so
far;
(b) the details of SEZs which have
started developing infrastructure,
State-wise;
(c) the details of SEZs which have
started commercial operations; and
(d) the details of employment in each
SEZ, State-wise classification thereof?
Import of insulating materials
†*196. SHRI SHREEGOPAL VYAS:
SHRI RUDRA NARAYAN
PANY:
 Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether all the wires and cables used
for power generators and flow of electricity
are manufactured in India;
(b) whether talks have been held in the
matter with the manufacturers of electrical
appliances;
(c) whether the need for import of
insulating materials used in some of the
cables like high thermal wire has been felt;
and
(d) if so, whether any efforts are being
made to develop them in the country?
Plan allocation for textiles during
Eleventh Plan
*197. SHRI S. ANBALAGAN: Will the
Minister of TEXTILES be pleased to
state:
(a) the plan allocations made for textiles
during the Eleventh Plan period,
sector-wise;
(b) the percentage of decrease/increase
over the allocations made for textiles during
the Tenth Plan period, sector-wise;
(c) whether any new sehemes are
proposed to be launched for the
development of textile sector during the
Eleventh Plan period; and
(d) if so, the details of the schemes
alongwith the targets fixed for achievement?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

60
Construction of roads under PMGSY
in Himachal Pradesh
†*198. SHRI RAJNITI PRASAD: Will
the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that construction
of roads under Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak
Yojana (PMGSY) is not getting completed
on time in Himachal Pradesh and
particularly in district Shimla;
(b) if so, the names of such roads
alongwith names of contractors who are
delaying construction of roads;
(c) whether Government proposes to
take action against the contractors and
officers responsible for slow pace of
construction work of roads; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Disparity between farmers and rural
workers
*199. SHRI PRAVEEN
RASHTRAPAL: W ill the Minister of
RURAL DEVELOPMENT be pleased to
state:
NEW DELHI; V . K. AGNIHOTRI,
The 5th March, 2008 Secretary-General.
Phalguna 15, 1929 (Saka)
(a) the reasons for great economic divide
between urban and rural India, inspite of
'Bharat Nirman' programme declared by
Hon'ble Prime Minister;
(b) the details of various programmes
implemented through his Ministry to
remove disparity of farmers and rural
workers; and
(c) whether Government has succeeded
in stopping migration of workers from
villages to towns due to National Rural
Employment Guarantee Act (N.R.E.G .A.)?
Non-payment of compensation for
acquired land in Jammu by BSF
*200. SHRI T.S. BAJWA: Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that BSF has
acquired cultivated land at Bedipur village
in RS Pura sector, Jammu district, for more
than ten years and no compensation yet
has been paid to farmers; and
(b) if so, the reasons for not paying the
compensation?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

I N D E X
(Ministry-wise)
Commerce and Industry : 185, 186, 195, 196,
Defence : 181, 188, 192,
Earth Sciences :—
Home Affairs : 182, 187, 200,
Information and Broadcasting : 184, 194,
Labour and Employment : 191,
Parliamentary Affairs :—
Rural Development : 189, 193, 198, 199,
Science and Technology : 183,
Textiles : 190, 197.
